The '''''Redemption''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]]. It was refitted with advanced medical facilities and served the fleet as the primary medical frigate, but could also hold its own in combat.

==Characteristics==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] had many such [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate|Nebulon-B escort frigates]] and used them for a wide array of purposes. The ''Redemption'' was a [[hospital ship]], and most of its weapons had been swapped out for more shielding and sensors. The entire [[starfighter]] [[hangar]] was transformed into a hospital that could house over 700 patients. The survival rate for the injured was nearly 98%.<ref name="Complete Vehicles, New Edition" />

==History==
[[File:Rebel_fleet_ESB.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Redemption'' with the rebel fleet]]
In the wake of the [[Battle of Hoth]] and utilizing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] scatter protocol, the ''Redemption'' was assigned to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet's]] [[Fourth Division]].<ref name="Star Wars 1">[[Star Wars (2020) 1|''Star Wars'' (2020) 1]]</ref>

After [[Luke Skywalker]] was [[Escape from Cloud City|rescued]] from [[Cloud City]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' brought him to the ''Redemption'', where he was given a [[mechno-arm]] to replace the one he lost [[Duel on Cloud City|dueling]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Episode V" />

The ''Redemption'' later participated in the [[Battle of Endor]]—which was won by the Rebel Alliance<ref name="Episode VI" />—where its medical facilities were pressed into service dealing with the multitude of injured personnel. Although the frigate survived the battle, one of the nurses on board, [[Able Nereno]], was killed at his post when an [[oxygen]] tank exploded near him.<ref name="Shattered Empire 2">[[Shattered Empire 2|''Shattered Empire'' 2]]</ref>
